text:
Dina: Heads-up — planning a regional traffic grooming for eu-west -> apac next Tue 02:00 UTC. Goal: shift steady-state routing for ~20% of requests to apac region to prime caches and probe cold-path perf before the larger rollout. Who can own the deploy and smoke?
Sam: I can own the deploy and execute the traffic steps. Confirming timeline 02:00 UTC works for me.
Leo: I’ll own infra checks & DNS actions (TTL + weight changes). Quick Q: do we plan to lower DNS TTL? I need to know provider behavior for 30s vs 60s.
Dina: Yes — plan is to set TTL to 30s 20m prior, then perform staged weight shifts. If provider won’t allow 30s, fallback 60s and extend stage windows.
Katie: I’ll be on-call for realtime monitoring during the window. Please post the dashboard links and smoke cmds.
Dina: Smoke checklist (short):
````
# smoke curl to edge gateway from prod jump host
curl -H "X-Test-Client: smoke" https://api.redwood.example/health
# check routing header
curl -I https://app.redwood.example/ | grep -i x-edge-region
# k8s rollout status (control plane)
kubectl -n prod rollout status deploy/edge-router --timeout=2m
````
Also run the tracing sampler quick-query: console/observability/trace?q=service:edge-router+percentile:95
Sam: For the staged weights I propose: 5% (10m) -> 20% (10m) -> 50% (10m) -> 100% (10m). If any stage shows >2% 5xx or 2x latency p95 vs baseline, abort and revert. Sounds OK?
Leo: Sounds good. I’ll prepare DNS playbook: change TTL to 30s at T-20m, then update weights via routing service. Rollback plan: revert weights to original and restore TTL to previous value. I’ll post exact commands beforehand.
Dina: Add-ons:
- Canary headers & logs: include X-Canary:true for the routed cohort so we can filter logs.
- Metrics to watch: edge_request_rate, edge_5xx_rate, edge_p95_latency, origin_error_rate.
- Alert thresholds: edge_5xx_rate > 1% sustained for 2m -> manual rollback; edge_p95_latency > 2x baseline for 5m -> consider rollback.
Sam: Can someone confirm the feature-flag state? I want to ensure new routing policy is behind the rollout flag so we can flip quickly if needed.
Leo: Routing policy is behind flag "regional-tilt-apac-2025" in the config service. I’ll verify flag present and deploy-bot can toggle.
deploy-bot: scheduled action created for 1745007200 (02:00:00 UTC) to execute weight updates if approved.
Katie: Dashboard links: observability/edges/regions (live), errors/edge (alerts panel), runbooks/edge-tilt (runbook). I’ll be on calls if alerts hit.
Sam: I’ll post the exact deploy commands 1h before window and pin the thread. Also I’ll run preflight smoke at T-30m.
Dina: Preflight checklist for T-30m:
- Leo: set TTL to 30s (or confirm fallback), post DNS TTL confirmation.
- Sam: preflight curl and rollout dry-run.
- Katie: validate alerting mute window configured correctly (so only critical ones page).
- Dina: confirm tracing and log filters for X-Canary are ready.
Leo: Quick note — cert rotation for edge-router completed last week but I’ll recheck cert expiry windows to avoid surprises.
Sam: thumbs-up. I’ll also coordinate with solutions-eng to expect a small uptick in API keys hitting apac.
Dina: If anything is green after the 100% shift, we’ll keep the new policy and revert TTL back to 300s after 1h stable. If not, rollback immediately and follow postmortem steps in runbook.
Katie: I’ll standby 01:30–03:30 UTC. Ping @katie if you want me to trigger rollback.
Sam: On it. I’ll update this thread at T-60m and T+5m with status.
Dina: Great — thanks all. Quick ask: @Leo can you paste the exact DNS provider commands / UI steps in this thread so anyone can follow?
Leo: Will do — posting now:
````
# DNS (provider CLI) example
provider dns update-zone --zone redwood.example --set-ttl 30
provider dns change-weights --zone redwood.example --record edge.redwood.example --weights "eu:95,apac:5"
# subsequent steps to increase to 20/50/100 etc using same CLI
````
Leo: Also note: if provider rate-limits weight updates, we’ll slow the stage cadence.
Sam: Copy. Thanks everyone — will ping when I start the preflight. :thumbsup:
